profile.summary: Destination College Advising Corps is a University of California, Berkeley program that places recent college graduates in high schools as full-time College Adviser Fellows. The advisers help low-income, first-generation and underrepresented students prepare for and apply to college. It operates under UC Berkeley's Center for Educational Partnerships.
